   pe=p-self.k.site_xpos[self.sid]
   re=Rotation.from_matrix(R@self.k.site_xmat[self.sid].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
   if np.linalg.norm(pe)<0.0001 and np.linalg.norm(re)<.001: break
   mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,self.k,jp,jr,self.sid)
   J=np.vstack([jp[:,self.vidx],jr[:,self.vidx]*.4]);e=np.r_[pe,re*.4]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+.001**2*np.eye(6),e)
   dq*=min(1,.15/max(np.abs(dq)))
   self.k.qpos[self.qidx]+=dq
   for j in [1,3,5]:
    lim=self.m.joint('robot_joint_'+str(j+1)).range

 def move(self,p=None,R=None,grip=0,steps=80,tol=.003,base=None, quiet=False):
